issue.title: ArgumentCaptor: NPE when an null array is passed to a varargs method
issue.body:
A NullPointerException is thrown if an null array is passed to a varargs method.

```
@Test
public void shouldCaptureVarArgs_nullArrayArg() {
        String[] argArray = null;
        mock.varargs(argArray);

        verify(mock).varargs(captor.capture()); //<- Kaboom NPE
}
```

Since an vararg is simply an array the ArgumentCaptor should reject it silently. This relates to #565.


input.args: Issue 583: ArgumentCaptor NPE when a null array is passed to a varargs method. Evidence opened: mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/internal/invocation/InvocationMatcher.java (captureArgumentsFrom, now delegates to MatcherApplicationStrategy; the old captureVarargsPart method from the trace no longer exists) and mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/internal/invocation/MatcherApplicationStrategy.java (forEachMatcherAndArgument checks isVarArgs and matcher type, then uses getRawArguments). Related: 565, 584, 585.

Reply drafted by following the `repro-check` checklist:

- **Version:** not stated.
- **Snippet:** yes, a complete test method.
- **Expected and actual behaviour:** yes. The reporter expects no exception and gets an NPE.
- **Stack trace:** yes.

The snippet, expected and actual behaviour are all present, so the report is reproducible as written. The trace names `captureVarargsPart`, which no longer exists in this source tree, so I'm asking the reporter to confirm the version.

Could you confirm which version you saw the NPE on?"}
